title: I Tried Using the Internet!
overview: Lorna goes on an adventure with her skill, the Internet, which grants her access to near infinite knowledge.

title: I Tried Becoming an Adventurer!
overview: Lorna arrives in Aiphoné and goes to register with the adventurer's guild.

title: I Tried Looking At Message Boards!
overview: Lorna must overcome a dungeon considered impossible to complete if she wants to pass the exam.

title: I Tried Stopping Someone's Ambition!
overview: Lorna unexpectedly saves an elf and is taken to the hidden elven village plagued by a strange disease.

title: I Tried Quitting Being a Savior!
overview: While the elves celebrate the end of the plague, Lorna feels guilty about being revered as their Savior.

title: I Tried Becoming a God!
overview: Lorna visits the port town of Aquas and discovers why the townsfolk are terrified of Wednesdays.

title: I Tried Making a Secret Weapon!
overview: Lorna helps Aries complete the weekly Wednesday mission.
